idempotency.duplicate_guard: zip-slip safe extraction + per-file source hash/path + child ingest duplicate guards
idempotency.idempotency_key: sha256(content-v2: norm_path+crc32+size từng member accepted, sort)+mode+cat_or_profile
idempotency.journal_key: batch item path + child pipeline journal
idempotency.readback_command: ingest-zip <file.zip> --cat <NN> --json then inspect each child_result; run live-state-diff after smoke
idempotency.resume_behavior: rerun same zip apply; accepted members are re-planned and child pipelines perform duplicate/readback gates
idempotency.rollback_hint: use per-child journals plus live-state-diff; undo registry per run before any Drive/NLM cleanup

note: DRY-RUN only: zip là container đầu vào; không upload zip nguyên vào Drive/NLM.
